name: services/guide/chapter
description: Allows to get an university guide chapter by its id.
brief_description: Get a single university guide chapter info.

arguments.name: chapter_id
arguments.description:
Id of the guide chapter. You may think of chapters as of categories
                    that group pages on similar topic.

arguments.name: lang
arguments.description: A code of the preferred language ("pl" or "en"). It may influence the order of pages in the chapter.

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector may contain any subset of fields, which are described in the returns section.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
A dictionary of selected fields:

  • Primary:

    • id - Id of the guide chapter;

    • title - Title of the guide chapter as a langdict (you can use it eg. as a tab name);

    • pages - Pages that belong to the chapter.

      This field references objects returned by page method. See its returns section for possible subfields.

result_fields.name: title
result_fields.description:
Title of the guide chapter as a langdict
                                    (you can use it eg. as a tab name)

result_fields.name: pages
result_fields.description: Pages that belong to the chapter
